run_healthcheck_metrics_server: run the starlette healthcheck sidecar app that exposes metrics on all routes
compute_app_metrics: compute and return current connection count and application status as prometheus metrics
check_app_status: check if the main ASGI app is ok, busy, or error by sending a timed HTTP request
count_established_connections: count the number of established TCP connections to a given app port
find_gunicorn_process: find the gunicorn process listening on a specified port using psutil network connections
